next_qwen_family_design.objective: Express the real Qwen3.5-2B prefill128/decode1 consumer as one immutable typed Graph with a finite exact family, using existing provider routing/native programs and family-local constant ownership; preserve reusable single-machine architecture.
next_qwen_family_design.conclusion: The current public shape/Graph/finite-family interfaces can express this complete consumer without a model executor or global cache. The new ordinary batch query extent contract removes the known R=C blocker. Most changes belong in the test consumer: it currently builds one concrete Recipe/Graph/schema per token count. Symbolic output declarations and real reshape materialization must be authored deliberately. Two interface ergonomics limitations are explicit below; neither requires a model-specific mechanism.

shape_constraints: Model::prepare creates a new Recipe, BatchSchema(max_query_rows=tokens), Graph, constant-expression compilation and two slots for each token count. main already knows prompt/continuation/decode sizes before model evaluation and prepares all of them before first-token timing.
Recipe stores only concrete TensorDesc and calls infer_output_descriptions before GraphBuilder.add_node, so merely changing CompileOptions to kFiniteExact cannot produce a symbolic source Graph.

Raw checkpoint weights are already one shared Model::weights bank, frozen once into original StorageOwner/ReadLease. The duplicated work is separate Graph/shape-independent derived constant preparation and control work; do not claim raw checkpoint allocations are duplicated across phases.
Recipe::reshape currently tests concrete strides and inserts Copy when flattening is not a legal metadata View. That logic must not disappear in a symbolic rewrite.

independent_parameter_recommended_with_c.reason: The final-token slice needs start=T-1. The current checked shape algebra has addition/product/exact quotient/broadcast, no subtraction, and Dimension.fixed(-1) is invalid. One nonnegative L plus derived T expresses the exact relationship without a second independent parameter, sampled formula inference or a runtime tensor-index input. ProviderShapeRange accepts zero.
independent_parameter_recommended_with_c.empty_input: Existing evaluate rejects empty ids. Do not turn this into support for T=0.

minimum_consumer_change.change: Represent authored values as TensorSpec rather than assuming every intermediate is a concrete TensorDesc. Keep weights/constants concrete. Add explicit output-spec support to op/one and small same-shape/linear/known-custom helpers; retain original concrete inference for all-concrete nodes. Use ViewSpec for symbolic reshape/slice, and explicit existing materializations for noncontiguous layouts.

Separate one family program (source Graph/ports, one BatchSchema, literal owners, compiled family) from per-exact-point run storage. Compile once with kFiniteExact and unique startup points. Each phase keeps actual-sized tokens/positions/probe outputs, selected child/report and its original two parity slots. Do not keep a separate CompiledGraph for every T.

Collect the already known nonempty prompt/continuation/decode sizes into a finite table, derive Cq, and cold prepare the family before ready/first-token timestamp. An unlisted evaluate size returns an explicit need-to-prepare error; do not JIT or grow a phase cache during submit.

Select the already prepared exact child at cold invocation creation; retain existing original Queue, two state parity buffers, layout generation, metadata upload/native planning, resource bindings and prepare_replay/submit/Completion. Update positions and layout from length+T without specializing on length.

The finite parent has no execution route and zero per-route workspace/step counts. Use exact_variant child Executable/CompileReport for provider/kernel/workspace/output ownership and family total_* for unique storage. Public child physical_value reports expose concrete descriptions for diagnostic buffers/boundary dumps; do not rebuild an extra exact Graph on the normal path merely to recover descriptors.

The published-probe graph intentionally changes visible readers/fusion and may remain a separate immutable family. Preserve drain-before-owner-destruction for every original slot and retain literals/weights/StorageOwner through all family uses. Do not share opaque prepared state between distinct normal/probe Graph identities.

base_fixes_not_required_for_this_family: No global or cross-Graph constant cache.
No per-kernel warm route or model/operator whitelist.
No new GDN/conv semantics or dispatcher.
No R=C padding or independent history-length shape bucket.

constant_sharing.mechanism: compile_family uses one ConstantArtifactCache across all finite child plans. Keep the same immutable source node/value IDs, actual checkpoint root owners/leases, constant descriptions and destination resource. The existing ggml CUDA constant-expression provider may then reuse qualified Cast/norm-scale/Exp/Neg payloads.
constant_sharing.what_is_not_guaranteed: Different T can legitimately select different region covers, source/provider implementations, cold expression frontiers or packing layouts. Keys include actual used root identities/offsets/descriptions and folded-node/frontier identities. One source Graph is necessary but does not promise that every194 prior cold kernel disappears.
constant_sharing.measurement: Compare sum of each child compiled_storage/packed bytes with family total_compiled_storage, which deduplicates proven shared owners. Observe actual cold kernel/upload counts and retained buffers for the new family. There is no need to invent a public cache-hit counter or reuse unqualified artifacts.
constant_sharing.budget: Raw320 tensor weights are already shared. Prior194 cold kernels consume only about0.25ms accumulated GPU time in the existing reviewed trace; host setup/graph construction/routing/slots remain significant and cannot be called all recoverable.
constant_sharing.optional_small_consumer_cleanup: Identical immutable scalar literals may be interned within this one Recipe by exact dtype/bits if useful. This is optional, not a cross-model/global cache and not permission to merge numerically different F32/BF16 literals.

performance_and_correctness_boundary: First verify both selected child shapes and actual attention R/A without altering schema Cq/context capacity, visible KV history, positional math, numerical casts, state publication or graph output readers.

Use the original fixed128 prompt and31 forced decode inputs; compare all64 retained hidden/logits vectors byte-for-byte plus prediction/tape, state feedback and continuation semantics where already selected. A metadata refactor can change lowering/fusion and must not be assumed numerically inert before the real run.

Keep old and new weight-loader, construction, shape preparation, native batch preparation, capture, submit/final completion, mapping/file/runtime cleanup and TTFT boundaries identical. Both paths already prepare all requested shapes before first-token timing; no compile or wait may be moved outside the measured journey.

Use child reports for physical routes/workspace; count cold native kernels/uploads and family unique artifacts separately from steady decode kernels. Family compilation does not itself prove faster decode.

Only after the small actual correctness/native journeys pass, perform a bounded interleaved unprofiled separate-process comparison against the same current baseline and reference on the same device. Report startup/TTFT/prefill/decode and memory using equivalent work; profiler API/kernel sums are diagnostic, not wall-time savings.
Reuse the tested common owners and existing caches/SDKs. No all-model/backend Cartesian rebuild or broad verification framework is needed for this consumer refactor.
